boxes.text:
- Connect either by name or by addr (IP) and port. 
- Connect to the device by name, the addr and port will be filled in automatically.
- Unless you have an advanced setup, port will always be 5678.
Double-click in a locked patcher to open and export rnbo~ code to your remote device
The "host_names" message retrieves a list of discovered remote rnbo devices
The instance info lists the parameters, inports, outports and data_refs
Set a remote to connect to.
the set_names status output lists all the set names
Use the "setname" attribute to load a set by name and see a list of the available sets
Create a set named "foo". *NOTE* you must have at least 1 instance loaded to save a set
Graph sets can be loaded, saved, renamed and deleted on the remote device with the rnbo.remote object
The patcher_names status output lists all the patcher names
If an instance of the patcher is loaded when a "patcherdestroy" is issued for, the instance will remain loaded. If a loaded patcher is renamed it will retain its old name until it is loaded again.
Load a patch on the runner
Remove patcher from the runner's cache

The "patchername" attribute displays the currently loaded patcher and also lets you change that by name. An attrui looking at "patchername" should have a drop down listing patchers you have available to load.
Multiple patches exported to the device can be remotely loaded, renamed and removed.
Control the timing of the remote device for all objects locked to the external transport from the rnbo.remote object
Control device transport tempo (beats per minute)
Messages can be set to named inport objects in the left inlet
Named inport and outport objects exported to the remote device can be accessed by messages to the rnbo.remote object
Outport Messages are sent out the left outlet

The instance info is useful for inspecting named inports and outports on your rnbo.remote device.  will tell you what inport message tags you can use and also what outport tags you can expect to receive.
If the file fails to load the attribute will become empty.
Data Referencing objects such as buffer~ and data can be set from the rnbo.remote object with local files on the remote device
Set file to be referenced on the named data ref on rnbo.remote device.
Set the MIDI channel to use for mapping program change messages to preset index
Presets exported the remote device can be loaded, deleted, saved, and prioritized from the rnbo.remote object
The instance_presets  info lists the current remote's presets
Display/edit the intial preset to load on remote reboot
MIDI messages sent to the left inlet of the rnbo.remote are sent to midiin objects on the remote device.
The Middle Outlet receives  MIDI messages sent to a midiout object.
Send MIDI formatted messages to a RNBO device and get notified of changes to MIDI on the remote device
The instance info is useful for inspecting named paramters on the rnbo.remote device.
Named attributes of the rnbo.remote object
Parameters exported to the remote device can be accessed as attributes of the associated rnbo.remote object
The number of milliseconds to ignore incoming parameter updates after local feedback for feedback suppression
